overview: Recurrence banana (counting se), solve karna (characteristic equation), induction proofs.
coreConcept: Linear recurrence a_n = c1 a_(n-1) + c2 a_(n-2): characteristic equation x^2 = c1 x + c2.
hinglishExplanation: Counting problem ko last-step cases me todkar recurrence banta hai (e.g., no two consecutive 1s: a_n = a_(n-1) + a_(n-2)). Solve ke liye roots nikalo ya values compute karo.
formalDefinition: Linear recurrence a_n = c1 a_(n-1) + c2 a_(n-2): characteristic equation x^2 = c1 x + c2.
importantProperties: Characteristic equation roots se closed form.
standardTechniques: Initial values likh ke 5-6 terms compute karo.
